title: My vibecoded game has over 10k downloads! But I need to increase retention.
author: MosesSecondofHisName
selftext:
I'm pretty proud of this rhythm incremental game I made--it combines blacksmithing with blues music. I've managed to get a lot of people to download it, but it doesn't look like that many players are really sticking to it. The players who are sticking seem to REALLY enjoy it (some of them are basically getting to near-endgame content in a week--it's supposed to take a month). Any ideas for how to increase retention? Is it possible it just isn't reaching the right people?

For tech info, I built the game entirely through Chat GPT/Codex, with some graphical assistance from Adobe Firefly.

Here's a link to a short teaser/ad for the game: [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Lo0ZSpgX0mE](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Lo0ZSpgX0mE)
